name: Nix
gm_notes: Session 2 river crossing. Shapechanger: starts disguised as a harmless traveler or local (DC 15 Insight to see through before it attacks). River Bound: advantage on attack rolls and 10 HP regeneration per turn while submerged within 1 mile of its river. Luring Song: DC 13 WIS save or charmed, moves toward the water.
